describe.summary: The most recent defined value, with its date. The usual way to ask "what is it now?".

describe.name: extremes
describe.summary: The lowest and highest values over the whole series, each with its date.

describe.name: percentileRank
describe.summary: Where the latest value sits within the series’ own history, as a 0–1 fraction. Answers "is this unusual?" without needing a second series to compare against.

describe.name: shape
describe.summary: The whole series in at most `points` equal row bins, one point per bin at the bin end time. `how` sums up each bin: `sample` (its last value, the default), `mean`, `median`, `min`, `max`, `minMax` ([time, lo, hi], so a spike always shows) or `minMaxFirstLast` ([time, lo, hi, first, last]). Also reports `first`, `last`, `min` and `max` over the whole series, each { value, at }, to label the line. The honest answer to "show me the series" for a caller paying by the token.
